summary: Anthony Daniels ran for the Alabama House District 53 seat in the November 2014 election. He won with a two-party vote margin of approximately +55.7 points, defeating Republican Christian Horn who received 22.2 percent of the vote. The district was approximately 70 percent nonwhite. Daniels held pre-election roles including chairing the NEA Student Program and serving on the Alabama Education Association state board, establishing an education-labor identity. He later demonstrated a progressive record on issues such as Medicaid expansion and abortion.
